How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions / Orders?

Modified on: Tue, 4 Jun, 2024 at 11:20 AM

There are three ways to end a member's subscription from the admin area.

Method 1: Transaction History

  1. Go to Finance >> Transaction History.
  2. Search for the member by name or ID.
  3. Open Actions >> End Subscription.

Method 2: Subscriptions tab

Go to My Members >> Search Members, click Actions >> Payment History, open the Subscriptions tab and click Actions >> End Subscription.

What happens to the member

Ending a subscription from the admin dashboard does not deactivate the member's account. To hide the member, change the member status manually.
